offering_description.value: Designs fabless mixed-signal and audio integrated circuits, such as audio converters, amplifiers and haptic drivers, sold to device makers. Customers build them into phones, laptops, earbuds and other consumer and automotive products.

primary_products.value: audio codecs; audio amplifiers; haptic drivers; wireless charging chips; sensor interface chips

customer_segment.value: B2B: electronics device makers, contract manufacturers, automotive electronics suppliers

end_markets.value: smartphones; laptops and PCs; wearables and earbuds; automotive; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: chips sold to device makers and through distributors; licensing or royalties: software licenses for audio processing algorithms

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: designs chips that are built by outside foundries and sold to device makers for integration

geography_served.value: global: sales to customers in Asia, Europe and North America, with main design and sales offices worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: audio, haptics, sensing and power chips sharing mobile and consumer electronics customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to major device makers; distributors / dealers: independent electronic component distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls on semiconductor technology and environmental rules on chip materials, such as RoHS compliance
